facts.fact: CERT.tg, the Centre National de Réponse aux Incidents de Cybersécurité, issued public alert 202504/AP/09 on 27 April 2025 about a phishing campaign using a fake free-data offer in the names of Yas Togo and Moov Africa Togo.
